title: How to Body Swap a Photo With AI (Free, Step-by-Step Guide)
summary: Body swap a photo in five steps with Magic Hour. Learn which two images to upload, how to improve pose and lighting, free limits, privacy and usage rights.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**To body swap a photo, open Magic Hour Body Swap, upload the original scene, then upload a clear photo of the person who should appear in that scene.**


Select Swap Bodies, inspect the result, and download or retry with better-matched source images. The current guest workflow allows three free body swaps per day with no signup and no watermark.


Body swap is for replacing one person’s overall appearance in a still image. Use Face Swap when only facial identity should change, Head Swap when the whole head should change but the body and pose should remain, or Multiple Face Swap when several identities must be mapped in one photo. Product behavior checked September 13, 2026.


If the job should change only facial identity, follow[the photo and video face-swap guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/how-to-face-swap) instead of replacing the whole person.

### Replace one person in a photo


Upload the original scene first, then the clear photo of the person who should appear in it. Start with similar pose, angle and lighting.


[Try Body Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/body-swap)


## What you need before starting


-


**Original scene:** the still photo whose existing person will be replaced.


-


**Person photo:** a clear, well-lit view of the person who should appear in the scene.


-


**Permission:** the rights to upload both images and consent to use any recognizable person’s likeness.


-


**A stable comparison:** keep the original scene fixed when testing a different person photo, pose or crop.


For the person photo, a straight-on or slight angle usually gives the system more usable facial and body detail. In the original scene, choose a subject who is visible and not heavily covered by hands, hair, objects or deep shadow. Similar camera angle, framing and lighting make the two inputs easier to reconcile.


## How to body swap a photo in five steps


### 1. Open Body Swap


Open[Magic Hour Body Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/body-swap) . The page is for still images and one replacement per generation. The first upload is the original scene; the second is the person to swap in.


Retained Body Swap interface: upload the original scene on the left and the person who should appear in it on the right. Allowance badges belong to this earlier interface.


### 2. Upload the original scene


Choose the photo whose existing subject should be replaced. Check that the subject is large enough to inspect and that the body outline is not hidden by a tight crop or foreground object.


Retained target-scene example. The original scene is loaded first; the replacement-person input remains empty in this screenshot.


### 3. Upload the person photo


Choose a clear photo of the person who should appear in the scene. If the first result changes identity, hands, clothes or proportions in an unwanted way, use a source with a closer pose, camera angle and crop before repeating the same inputs.


### 4. Select Swap Bodies


Start the generation and wait for the complete result. Do not judge only the face or a small preview. Review the head-to-body join, hands, clothing boundaries, background, lighting and any object that crosses the subject.


### Using the signed-in editor


The guest instructions above use the Swap Bodies action. In the[signed-in Body Swap editor](https://magichour.ai/create/body-swap) , Scene to edit is the original photograph and Person to use is the replacement person. Upload both, choose the available output resolution, review the credit estimate and select Generate Image. The guest daily allowance does not price this account-based job.


The[Body Swap guide](https://help.magichour.ai/en/articles/16917102-body-swap-step-by-step-guide) explains that both images influence the generated scene: exact pose, clothing and surrounding detail are not guaranteed. If the wrong person changes, simplify the scene to one clear main subject. If only a shirt needs replacing, use a garment-reference clothes change rather than replace the whole person.


### 5. Review, download or retry


Download the result only after checking it at full size. If one area fails, change one input variable at a time: a clearer person photo, a closer pose, a less obstructed scene or more similar lighting. Keeping the scene fixed makes it easier to see which change helped.


Historical result in the same target scene. This screenshot contains a watermark and earlier signup offer; neither establishes current download or plan rules.


## How to improve a body swap


-


**Identity looks wrong:** use a sharper person photo with a visible face and less filtering.


-


**Body proportions look wrong:** choose a person photo and target scene with more compatible pose and framing.


-


**A hard edge appears:** match lighting and avoid scenes where hair, hands or clothing obscure the body boundary.


-


**Hands or objects change:** use a less obstructed scene or treat the result as a concept that needs manual editing.


-


**The wrong person changes:** use a scene with one clearly visible main person. Multiple Face Swap maps facial identities; it is not a group body-replacement selector.


-


**Text or logos distort:** restore exact typography and brand marks in an image editor after approving the person and composition.


## Body swap, clothes change or image editing?


Use Body Swap when a different person should occupy the scene. Use[AI Clothes Changer](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-clothes-changer) when the person should remain but the outfit should change. Use[AI Image Editor](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-editor) for targeted background, object, lighting or text corrections after the composition is accepted.


For a face-only edit, use[Face Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) . For the full head while retaining the target body and pose, use[Head Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/head-swap) . For a group photo, use[Multiple Face Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/multiple-face-swap) and check every mapping before download.


## Other body-swap options: outfit control or manual compositing


[Facecam Body Swap](https://www.facecam.ai/body-swap) documents two outfit choices: Yours brings the replacement person’s clothing and shoes into the scene; From the scene uses the destination person’s outfit. Its guide asks for one person in each JPEG, PNG or WebP input and recommends a full-length replacement photo. These controls matter when deciding whether the new person should keep their own clothes or wear the scene’s existing look.


The Facecam page says a head-and-shoulders reference can require the rest of the person’s appearance to be filled in. If shoes, a jacket or a specific silhouette matter, supply a reference that shows them and inspect the finished result. The same page describes a Facecam mark on free JPEG outputs, removed by paid plans. Check the selected account offer and export requirements before buying; this source review does not establish a measured quality or processing-time advantage.


[Photoshop’s manual compositing method](https://helpx.adobe.com/photoshop/desktop/crop-resize-transform/transform-manipulate-reshape/combine-images-in-photoshop.html) is an alternative when you want to work with an approved person cutout. Put the replacement person on a separate layer, select them, refine hair and clothing edges in Select and Mask, and output a Layer Mask. Move and transform that layer into the scene, then adjust lighting and color. Choose a source pose and perspective that fit the composition; this method gives you explicit masking control and still requires editing work.


Keep these choices tied to the required deliverable. A generative body replacement can reconcile the person with a new scene, while a masked composite lets you choose which parts of the source layer are visible. Compare the entire person, outfit and scene. Do not promote a face-only swap to a full-body option merely because its preview looks convincing.


## Free limit, watermark and privacy


Magic Hour’s current Body Swap page states that guests receive three free body swaps per day without an account and that photo outputs have no watermark. Account credits and paid plans are separate. Verify the current quote in the interface before a larger job.


The current product page also states that guest uploads and outputs are automatically deleted after one day and are not used to train models. Do not rely on deletion as a substitute for permission: avoid uploading confidential material or a person’s likeness without authorization.


## Commercial use and consent


The[current terms](https://magichour.ai/terms-of-service) permit commercial use with a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase or separately agreed paid usage-based billing, subject to source rights and applicable law. Output created without one of these paid arrangements is limited to personal, non-commercial use. Review the terms before client, advertising or resale work.


A software license does not grant rights to a person’s likeness, a photographer’s image, a brand, costume or location. Obtain the necessary permissions, do not fabricate testimonials or evidence, and disclose a synthetic edit when context could mislead viewers.
